author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I’m tiling this shower with 12x24 porcelain. The T-Lock clips have 1/16 inch spacers. I use the wedges and clips to get consistent grout joints and flat tiles. Using the right tools makes projects like this easier. Many thanks to Perfect Level Master for sponsoring this tutorial #tileshower #bathroomremodel
